description: Update a contact's information: name, email, city, country, and the workspace's own contact custom fields (custom_fields: key → value, null clears). Call get_contact first to see which custom field keys exist, their types and allowed options. Only the fields you pass are changed.

custom_fields.description: The workspace's own contact custom fields, as an object of field key → value (e.g. {"ficha_cliente": "Cliente desde 2024, prefiere entregas por la mañana"}). Keys are defined by the workspace, so call get_contact first: its "custom_fields" list shows every available key with its type, label, current value and, for select fields, the allowed option values. Value formats by type: text/textarea/phone/email/url → string; number/currency → number; date → "YYYY-MM-DD"; datetime → "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"; boolean → true/false; select → one option value; multiselect → array of option values. Pass null (or "") to clear a field. Fields you leave out are not changed.

phone.description: Phone number of the contact to update

name: update_contact
